can someone help me understand why this is happening? can't sync any music right now...

The phone might be using the storage space as a swap file. Basically when programs run, they need more space for storing things like remembering which song you were playing, or loading textures from a game you were playing, etc. Ram is expensive, and not always necessary, so they use part of the internal storage as a slower version of ram. Although that space is technically "free", it may be being used by something in the background, like an APP, or the OS, or anything. So even though you have enough space to add your file, that space is technically being used by something else which has a higher priority right now.
I turned the phone off and on again and it still does this, restarted iTunes too. Can I turn off this 'feature' and prevent it from using my storage as swap space?

I don't know. But as I said, even turning your phone off and shutting down all the apps may not prevent this since your OS might be doing it.

You could try googling iphone + swap file. But be warned that if you can turn it off, it could really cripple the functionality of your phone since it would have to constantly collect the garbage, and re-extract all of the data. What used to take 2 seconds could end up taking 20 seconds or even minutes.
You are probably correct, but even then, that message is terrible. It ought to take into account the swap space & subtract it from the reported free space.
